verdict.rationale: New Relic exposes substantial programmatic surface: NerdGraph (GraphQL API with an explorer) lets you query data and configure features. NRQL is the same query language that powers the UI's built-in charts and dashboards. A CLI, Terraform support for agent fleets and an official MCP server round this out. However, New Relic's own docs say NerdGraph configures only "some" New Relic features, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec, so full UI parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: evidence of complete API coverage of UI features (dashboards, SLOs, alerts, settings), a published machine-readable API spec, and independent confirmation of parity.
